aria: Heads up — published `sdk-js@2.1.0` and onboarding is failing for ESM/edge runtimes. Next.js edge import throws `Cannot find module './index.mjs'` and sourcemaps are missing. Anyone seen this?

mike: Reproduced on my Next edge app. Stack traces point at compiled CJS entry even though we expect ESM. `npm pack` shows only `dist/*.js`, no `.mjs`, no `.map` and no `.d.ts`.

jess: Confirmed. Build output in CI has `index.cjs` and `index.js` but the publish step filters files with `files` in package.json that only matched `.js`. Looks like the change in the release script dropped `.mjs` and maps. :facepalm:

aria: Likely cause: the new rollup step outputs `.mjs` but the `files` array and `prepare` script didn't include `.map` and `.d.ts`. Also `package.json` missing a proper `exports` map so bundlers pick wrong entry.

mike: For a hotfix we should publish 2.1.1 that includes both ESM and CJS artifacts, plus types and maps. Minimal `package.json` changes: add `types`, `module`, `main`, and an `exports` field mapping `import` -> `dist/index.mjs`, `require` -> `dist/index.cjs`. Also include `dist/*.map` in files.

jess: I pushed a branch with a patch and updated `files` to include `dist/*.mjs`, `dist/*.cjs`, `dist/*.map`, and `dist/*.d.ts`. Also added "types": "dist/index.d.ts" and an `exports` block. CI now runs `npm pack` in a job to assert package contents. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234

aria: @build-bot can you run the `pack` verification job before we cut the patch release?

build-bot: pack-check job passed. Artifact includes `index.mjs`, `index.cjs`, `index.d.ts`, and `index.js.map`.

sam: For release notes: call out breaking behavior for ESM/Edge and recommend users pinning to `2.0.x` if they need immediate rollback. Also add a short migration note for `module` vs `main`.

mike: Also adding a regression test in CI: `npm pack` -> `tar -xzf` -> attempt `node --input-type=module -e "import('./package/index.mjs')"` and a CJS require check. And update the publish workflow to run `git ls-files "dist/*"` to ensure we don't miss globs.

aria: Rolling out `2.1.1` now (patch). Will monitor errors and coordinate a small e2e on Next.js examples. Thanks for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

jess: After the publish, verified Next.js example imports fine and sourcemaps show correct frames. Closing the rollback task.

aria: Thanks all. Follow-up actionable items: 1) add pack check to publish pipeline 2) add smoke test that installs tarball and imports as ESM/CJS 3) double-check `exports` for subpath exports if we add more files. I'll file follow-ups.

mike: One more: add a linter rule or pre-publish hook to fail if `types` or `exports` are missing. That would have caught this earlier.

aria: Agreed. I'll create a tiny RFC in docs on publish hygiene.

aria: (closing) watching logs for the next 24h; please ping if you see any new reports.
